content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?The Hip-Hop Foodie's PostThe Hip-Hop FoodieMarch 5 at 9:13 PM · Shared with PublicChipotle is offering a BOGO free entrée deal on Friday, March 13, 2026 for customers who show a tattoo. The promotion runs 3–4 PM at participating U.S. locations and is in-restaurant only.
